assessment: No outstanding actionable safety, custody, scope or correctness finding for the observation-only probe.
review_basis: Read the entire 155-line B882Profile module and the entire run_restore_probe supervisor delta from the independently reviewed 234-line export-profile v2. Verified all eight current module hashes without import or execution.
checked_controls: No public writer, solver, mesher, save, recompute or profiler is invoked by the new probe. Existing identity-only native capability/policy queries remain expressly distinct from a physical solve.

Pinned original input bytes remain read-only; only a new labelled run and private observation files are created. No historical membership, native files or failed-attempt receipt is rewritten or rebound.

Only public node coordinates, volume IDs and getElementNodes sequences are observed. The first-ten difference report, node-count histograms and same-node-set counts explicitly do not prove type or orientation equivalence.

PASS means observations completed with stable selected native properties and original-byte custody. Differences from historical properties, node coordinates or ordered connectivity are recorded as observations, not silently normalized into a physical acceptance.
The restored ordered-connectivity JSON is a new private observation, hash/size linked from the probe receipt and independently captured by the supervisor.
Boolean-only comparisons and bounded samples avoid the earlier giant unittest dictionary-diff formatting path. Explicit phase updates and actual_write_inp_file_calls=0 clarify progress and scope.

The supervisor retains exact literal app identity, source/runtime separation, private profiles, null stdin, 120-second operational supervision, owned process-group cleanup, serial guards, input/manifest fences, full app/protected-directory custody and16 selected dependency pins.
All four diagnostic outputs are captured once; parsed receipt bytes and bounded log hash are bound, then all four files are end-fenced before supervisor PASS.

scope_limits.privacy: Raw app/protected-directory inventories, per-element observations and detailed paths remain private; this review grants no publication permission.
